text:
morgan: Heads up — nightly eval run showed a sudden accuracy regression for INT8 qprofile 'bin-sched-v3' on the summarization prompt set (summ-bank-14). Overall Rouge-L dropped from ~87.2 to ~74.6 compared to yesterday. FP8 variant is stable. Anyone seeing this?

alex: Which run ID / artifact? can you paste the eval link?

morgan: run-id: nightly-224000/eval-3452. Metrics snapshot: `ROUGE-L: baseline 87.2 -> bin-sched-v3 74.6, EM: 65.1 -> 55.0, avg latency unchanged`. FP8 (fp8-stable) was 86.9. Full logs at s3://redwood-nightly/nightly-224000/eval-3452/metrics.json

eval-bot: job completed: nightly-224000/eval-3452 (artifacts: s3://redwood-nightly/nightly-224000/eval-3452)

jamie: We merged the 'scale-scheduler' change yesterday (PR #3221) that adjusts per-layer binning windows during calibration. That touches the same codepath — cc @kevin. Could be the cause.

kevin: I can repro locally with a small reproducer. Command I used: `./tools/run_eval --model rwd-llama3-7b --mode quantize --qprofile bin-sched-v3 --prompts datasets/summ-bank-14.json --seed 42 --batch 8`

anita: Quick diff between calibration artifacts v2 -> v3 shows scale factors for attentions layers 3-6 increased by ~1.35x on average. That compresses dynamic range unexpectedly and shifts logits. Snippet from `calib_summary.txt`:
```
layer 3: scale_v2=0.72 scale_v3=0.98 (+36%)
layer 4: scale_v2=0.68 scale_v3=0.91 (+34%)
layer 5: scale_v2=0.75 scale_v3=1.01 (+35%)
```

morgan: The scheduler was intended to be adaptive but not that aggressive. Is there an easy sanity guard we missed?

kevin: Short-term mitigations: 1) revert PR #3221 for the nightly pipeline; 2) add automatic fallback in rollout to `baseline-int8-2024-11` when rouge delta > 5pts on any tracked prompt set; 3) add a regression unit test that replays 10 summarization prompts during CI. I'll open PRs. :thumbsup:

jamie: I'll open the revert right now and run a smoke eval. Also propose we add a tunable cap on per-layer bin scaling (e.g., max x1.2) until we validate across eval sets.

morgan: Sounds good. I'll also route affected production inference to FP8 fallback for the next 6 hours to be safe. Tagging SRE if we see customer errors. :warning:

deploy-bot: Canary updated: route rwd-llama3-7b-int8 -> fallback=fallback-fp8-7b (change-id: canary-224000A)

anita: Follow-up: minimal repro script and rouge diff posted in gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/repro-bin-sched-v3. Running that locally gives consistent ~12pt drop in Rouge-L with bin-sched-v3.

alex: Thanks for the triage. Is this blocking Dedicated customers today or only nightly?

morgan: Only saw it in nightly and a small Dedicated canary; no major customer incidents reported yet. Plan: revert, run overnight, if results are green reintroduce with capped window and expanded prompt sets. ETA ~6h.

jamie: Opening revert PR now: #3234. Will kick a full nightly rerun after it's merged.

kevin: I'll draft the regression test and fallback logic. Will ping when PRs are up.

morgan: Appreciate the quick response. Keep updates in this thread.
